answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Interest & Insurance Question ID: 161565 Country: India Title: The bank account of the masjid has earned some interest. My question is that what is the legal procedure of the said interest? Question: The bank account of the masjid has earned some interest. My question is that what is the legal procedure of the said interest? Answer ID: 161565 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1104/954/SD=9/1439) Interest money should be given in charity to the poor and needy ones without intention of reward whether the interest money is earned from the bank account of a mosque. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
